sections.heading: Welcome to Rhizome Springs
sections.body: Rhizome Springs is an off-grid community and gathering place on Salt Spring Island, BC. We host workshops, dance festivals, ecological learning, creative residencies, and community gatherings rooted in our connection to the land.

sections.heading: Embodiment
sections.body: Dance, movement, and somatic practices that deepen our relationship with our bodies and each other.

sections.heading: Ecology
sections.body: Learning to live in reciprocity with the land through permaculture, restoration, and ecological stewardship.

sections.heading: Creativity
sections.body: Art, music, building, and making as pathways to deeper understanding and community connection.

sections.heading: The Land
sections.body:
Rhizome Springs sits on 20 acres of forested land on Salt Spring Island, in the traditional territory of the Hul'q'umi'num' and SENCOŤEN speaking peoples. The property features old-growth forest, natural springs, meadows, and a growing network of gardens and gathering spaces.

We steward this land with care, guided by principles of ecological restoration and permaculture. Our buildings are hand-built using natural materials, and we live off-grid, powered by solar energy and spring water.

sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.body: Rhizome Springs is a living laboratory for regenerative culture. We believe that by deepening our relationship with the land, our bodies, and each other, we can discover new ways of living that are both sustaining and joyful. Through workshops, festivals, residencies, and daily practice, we explore what it means to be fully alive in community.

sections.heading: Movement, Dance & Somatic Practice
sections.body: We host contact improvisation jams, fusion dance festivals, and somatic workshops throughout the year. Our outdoor dance platform and indoor studio provide spaces for movers of all levels to explore their embodied experience. From ecstatic dance to structured technique classes, our programming invites participants to listen deeply to their bodies and discover new ways of moving together.

sections.heading: Land Stewardship & Permaculture
sections.body: Our ecological programming includes permaculture design courses, forest restoration work parties, wild food foraging walks, and natural building workshops. We practice and teach regenerative land management, seed saving, and food preservation. Living off-grid means learning to work with natural systems rather than against them.

sections.heading: Art, Music & Making
sections.body: Creativity is woven into everything we do at Rhizome Springs. From music jams around the fire to collaborative art projects, from woodworking to weaving, we believe that making things together builds community and deepens our understanding of the world. Our residency program invites artists and makers to spend time on the land, creating work inspired by this place.

sections.heading: Selena La Brooy
sections.body:
Selena is the founder and steward of Rhizome Springs. A certified Rolfer, dancer, and ecological builder, she has been tending this land since 2018. Her vision for Rhizome Springs grew from a lifelong passion for movement, community, and living close to the earth.

When not hosting events or working on the land, Selena maintains a Rolfing practice on Salt Spring Island, helping people find ease and alignment in their bodies.

sections.heading: Reach Out
sections.body: We love hearing from people who are curious about Rhizome Springs. Whether you want to attend an event, volunteer, propose a workshop, or just say hello, we would love to hear from you.

sections.heading: Ways to Get Involved
sections.body:
Attend an event - Browse our upcoming workshops, festivals, and gatherings.

Volunteer - We welcome work-trade volunteers who want to help with land stewardship, building, and event support.

Propose a workshop - Have a skill or practice to share? We are always open to collaboration.

Residency - Artists, makers, and practitioners can apply for time on the land.
